analysis: 源自拉丁语 advocare：ad-（向）+ vocare（呼喊），字面义为“召来相助”，故引申为“拥护、提倡”及“拥护者”。

meanings.meaning_en: to publicly support or recommend a particular cause or policy
examples: Many scientists advocate stricter controls on carbon emissions.

meanings.meaning_en: a person who publicly supports or recommends a particular cause or policy
examples: She has long been an advocate of equal pay for women.
